svg.title: DEBIX Model A J2 header map
svg.desc: All 40 J2 pins with their signals, the pins this manual uses, the pins to leave empty, and where the five 2.0 mm jumper housings A to E sit.
svg.text: J2 seen from above, Ethernet end at the bottom
odd pins: outer row, at the board edge
J2 has no 3.3 V pin. A to E are the five 2.0 mm jumper housings; each holds two wires.
